title: 2026 CPR House Race Ratings
scope: Complete set of 37 races in the publisher's Toss Up, Lean Democrat, and Lean Republican categories on its dated public ratings page.
retrievalMethod: Verified in the web search index of the original publisher page, including repeated source-specific search on September 4. Direct HTTP fetch returned 403, so a complete raw HTML download was not saved.
notes: These are Cook's qualitative race assessments, separate from any site-created scenario model.
Ratings are not polls or numerical win probabilities. Do not convert the categories into implied probabilities without a separate disclosed method.
District identifiers refer to Cook's 2026 ratings; they must not be joined silently to 2024 district geographies.
This extract omits candidate and incumbent names and all Solid/Likely individual rows. Likely categories are included only in aggregate counts.
Keep the August 25 publisher date visible; September 4 is the retrieval date.
